name: Branch codex custodian
design: Broad mature male with a flat wide brushed-bronze Yautja biomask, squared cheek shields and a double central recessed seam, thick scalp tendrils held in a low horizontal fan. Olive sleeveless overcoat with short moss-green half-cape, modest silver-grey segmented chest armor and brown covered leggings. Left arm cradles a thick CLOSED engraved metal-bound codex against ribs, right hand carries a short leather-capped cylindrical archive tube. Three small folio pouches and flat leaf-shaped bronze clasps across wide belt.
